requiredFiles.description: Problem statement, user stories, and team roles

criteria: The README includes a clear problem statement describing a specific, real-world problem
The README explicitly justifies why a web app is the right solution — explains why a spreadsheet, existing tool, or mobile-only app would NOT be sufficient
At least 3 user stories are written in the format: 'As a [user type], I want to [action] so that [benefit]'
Team roles are defined and assigned to specific named team members
figma-link.txt contains a valid URL to a Figma file or image with a wireframe sketch of at least one screen
